name: setup
description: One-time setup for the ymer marketplace — creates the store skeletons in your Ymer Node's notebook, checks the state folder and the ymer connection, creates the Meta Roadmap project, and checks all four again whenever you ask.

plans_dir.title: State folder
plans_dir.description: Optional. One folder for your state, under version control: /setup:env verifies it, and drained topics get folders beneath it. Leave it unset and topics are kept in your Ymer Node's notebook instead.
